basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Lead AI Engineer · Production Multi-Agent Systems · RAG, Evals & Observability · Founder · MBA
basics.summary: Lead AI engineer who ships production multi-agent systems that move company metrics. I run Anand Creations, a forward deployed engineering practice, and am currently deployed at LumApps building agents on LangGraph, Google ADK and GCP Vertex AI, forecast to generate $4M in approved opportunities per quarter. 13+ years building software for millions: LLM pipelines that eliminated $337K in vendor cost at Beekeeper, autonomous drone deliveries at Dronistics, co-evolution of robot brains and bodies at EPFL. Architect, builder, and tech lead in one. Verification-first by instinct: if the model cannot explain the output, it does not ship. Founded 3 companies on the side.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI agent program end-to-end: runtime, orchestration, integrations, governance, and rollout. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Built and deployed production multi-agent workflows for outbound sales on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI, using ReAct, self-reflection and hierarchical delegation, with tools exposed over MCP servers and agent state streamed to the UI over AG-UI. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast: $4M in approved opportunities per quarter; at 25% conversion, $1M in quarterly revenue.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, conversation transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware memory every agent reads and writes. Event-driven ingest over Pub/Sub, a per-agent query and write-back contract, and a freshness layer, grounding RAG retrieval to cut hallucinations.

Led technical discovery through production: agent runtime, eval pipelines, conversation-level tracing and tool-selection tuning, cost-per-request instrumentation across microservices. LumApps is a client engagement of my practice, Anand Creations; reports directly to C-level on outcomes.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who operates like a founding engineer. Owns the problem, designs the solution, ships to prod, stays accountable to the metric. Built AI-powered products used by millions while growing the engineering team.
highlights: Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an LLM pipeline built in 6 weeks (GitHub Actions + OpenAI). 12K+ assets translated, product team now iterates without external gatekeepers.
Built AI Onboarding Specialist giving every new signup personalized, high-touch guidance at scale. 100% of customers guided through setup without adding headcount.
Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end. Top revenue channel on the platform ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR). Designed for 99.99% SLA.
Built and mentored the AI engineering cohort. Hired for craft and curiosity, grew engineers who now lead features independently.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist and mentor for seed-to-VC stage startups. Evaluates architecture and advises on AI adoption and systems that scale.
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built everything from scratch: architecture, infrastructure, APIs, and the algorithms that made 500+ real-world deliveries possible.
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous delivery platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS) with real-time flight control APIs and logistics optimization. 500+ deliveries, 40% faster, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents.
Built cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipeline from scratch. Enterprise-grade reliability that enabled partnerships with Unilever and a CES showcase.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: AI research at the frontier of robotics. Built Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot morphologies and control systems via genetic algorithms. Foundational AI work that underpins my current agentic systems craft.
highlights: Engineered Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and brains via genetic algorithms. Morphology and neural control evolved together through artificial selection.
Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs impractical on local hardware. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.

education.institution: Quantic School of Business and Technology

publications.name: I Built an AI Outbound Agent. Here's What Actually Worked.
publications.summary: In-depth case study of building and deploying a production AI outbound sales agent. Architecture, implementation, and the real-world outcomes that led to 2x open rates and 2x approved opportunities.

publications.name: Your AI Needs a Brain, Not a Better Model
publications.summary: A map of the 12 memory and RAG tools building the AI brain layer: why temporal knowledge graphs beat vector-only RAG, and how to pick the right memory and retrieval stack for agents in production.

publications.name: Drafted, not sent: how I built the second half of an AI outbound agent.
publications.summary: How verification loops, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and draft-before-send patterns keep an autonomous agent from shipping wrong actions to real customers.

publications.name: Agentic AI: Simple ReAct Agent
publications.summary: Technical tutorial on building ReAct (Reasoning + Acting) agents. Combines reasoning capabilities with actionable decision-making for real-world applications.

publications.name: EPFL designs robots through artificial evolution
publications.summary: RoboGen, an open-source platform from EPFL, uses AWS and artificial evolution to co-evolve robot bodies and brains. Distributed experiments at cloud scale.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: AI agents that generate AND justify trading signals from technical and news data, with explainability and evaluation built in: if the model cannot explain the signal, it does not ship. Built the full stack solo (agent runtime, real-time market integrations, signal and justification layer, web frontend); live retail users after self-validating on my own portfolio.

projects.name: SwissNRI - Cross-border Fintech Platform
projects.description: First platform for Swiss-Indian families navigating FEMA, DTAA and Swiss regulations, replacing spreadsheets and expensive advisors. Compliance-first design: regulatory guardrails for both jurisdictions built before features. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months; feedback-driven iteration drove a 40% uplift in satisfaction.
